details:
The Post title describes my solution to an ongoing issue. More toxic players are joining vrchat, and there isn't a good way to get them booted out of an instance. So, I propose a fix to the vote kick system.
1. Decrease the amount of players required to votekick to around 4 or 5. It's really annoying that you can't votekick someone when a lobby has 7 players in it.

2. Make votekicking avalible to all instances. Right now I believe that votekicking is not available to public and Friends+, vote kicking should be available to all players. (If I'm incorrect in this assumption, please correct me.)

3. Add a system that punishes someone for falsely vote kicking. When selecting no to vote kick, you should be able to say if a vote kick was warranted or not. If the user has 5 unwarranted vote kicks in a row, the user is restricted from starting a vote kick.
title: Decrease the amount of people required to vote kick, and make vote kicking available to public servers
